status_note_ko: 초안. 고정·승인 아님. 차단 선행 조건 충족 뒤 관리 세션이 새 파일 prereg_main.json으로 고정한다.
author: claude (Opus 5.5), branch claude/main-study-prereg-draft
question_ko: 한국어 자연어 로봇 대화가 다중 로봇 팀 효율(실패를 분모에 남긴 SIM 시간)에 주는 효과

limits.cap_rule: after pilot, pooled over conditions: >20% of channel-condition trials hit utterance cap or >10% of all trials hit call cap -> double that cap before freeze; outcome metrics not inspected

hypotheses.multiplicity: graphical Holm (equal initial weights 1/3, equal re-allocation) combined with group-sequential boundaries (Maurer & Bretz 2013)
hypotheses.sign: variant - baseline on primary metric (PAR-2: lower is better)

primary_metric.name: par_makespan_sim_s
primary_metric.success: end_reason == 'orders_complete' (referee: every ordered item correctly delivered, once per item) and end_sim_s <= t0_sim_s + sim_horizon_s

switch_rule.definition: delivered_items / ordered_items (referee, once per item, at end_sim_s <= horizon)
switch_rule.trigger: blinded pooled pilot success rate (all 72 pilot trials, conditions not labelled) < 0.30
switch_rule.decided: once, after pilot, before any per-condition table; result committed

key_secondary.test: exact McNemar per contrast, separate Holm family over H1-H3

cost: tokens x unit_price (unit price not recorded; cost_usd null)

design.scenario_note: all six in the block design; seeds per scenario multiple of 3 -> blocks multiple of 18

pilot.role: external pilot, excluded from confirmatory analysis

design.main_seed_rule: 10000 + 100*k + j, j=1..18, used in order j
design.replicates: 1 of every 3 consecutive seeds per scenario drawn with RNG seed 20260928; all 4 conditions rerun once; averaged before pairing; ICC reported
design.order: blocks shuffled within each look segment, conditions shuffled within block, RNG seed 20260928, one trial at a time, load average recorded

n_reestimation.rho_hat: Fisher-z mean of the three contrast-pair Pearson correlations on scenario-centred block values of the (switched) primary metric
n_reestimation.rho_used: one-sided 80% lower bound tanh(atanh(rho_hat) - z0.8/sqrt(15)), clipped to [0, 0.8]

sequential.spending: Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming-type, two-sided, per hypothesis at its current local alpha
sequential.cohort_stop: only if all three H rejected at interim; otherwise run to N_plan

operational_stops: model string or proxy effective model changes
infra failures (HOST_ERROR incl. ENOSPC, API) > 10% cumulative
source or bundle hash differs from frozen
cumulative tokens > 1.3 x pilot-based projection (runaway guard, not an N rule)
design.operational_stop_consequence: report completed blocks as incomplete cohort, no effect claim, re-register a new cohort

tests.primary: paired sign-flip permutation on block differences, statistic = mean; exact if n<=20 else 1e5 Monte Carlo with fixed seed; compared to group-sequential nominal p
tests.stratified: scenario-stratified permutation decomposition; full per-block paired table
tests.mixed_model_secondary: log(PAR) ~ condition + scenario + (1|block), Kenward-Roger; NB GLMM for counts; logit GLMM for success; condition x scenario exploratory
tests.effect_rule: say 'effect' only if H rejected by graphical Holm + sequential boundary AND repeated CI excludes 0; opposite direction reported as such; otherwise 'not detected in this sample', never 'no effect'
tests.equivalence: only via TOST with margin +-0.20 (pooled-SD d), secondary

call_count_mediator.analysis: block-difference regression dPAR = c' + b*dcalls, product-of-coefficients, block bootstrap CI; exploratory

yoked_wake_arm.name: no_comm_yoked
yoked_wake_arm.rule: replay per-robot message_received call SIM times as empty-inbox re-calls labelled own_timer; everything else as no_comm

scale0_decomposition.estimand: total(scale1) = info(scale0 contrast) + cost(scale1 - scale0 difference); condition x scale interaction

key_message.s5: first utterance with claim absent(cyan_1) or drop of red_1

branch_replay.method: replay recorded model responses to the checkpoint just before delivery, then branch deliver vs block (recipient inbox), live calls afterwards, 1 run per branch

manipulation_checks.on_fail: report H results with label 'manipulation check failed'

failure_handling.only_retry: process died before the first model request -> rerun the same (block, condition) in place once; both attempts recorded; second failure counts as infra:HOST_ERROR
failure_handling.enospc_prevention: ugrp_session.py 10 GiB free-space gate before each trial
failure_handling.api: proxy upstream attempts <= 2 per POST; http_attempts recorded; api_failure counts as failure
failure_handling.sensitivity: exclude whole blocks with any infra failure (all 4 conditions); secondary only
failure_handling.balance_diagnostic: executor and infra failure rates by condition

dialogue_coding.coder_profile: native Korean, independent, not involved in implementation preferred; LLM is not a coder
dialogue_coding.blinding: free-Korean utterances only; condition/scenario/seed/time hidden; robot ids replaced by X/Y/Z; shuffled across conditions; structured mapped from enum
dialogue_coding.codebook: v1: 5 acts (report/request/order/objection/ack) + ISO 24617-2 map + info content codes + ellipsis-ambiguity + honorific level + failure attribution
dialogue_coding.codebook_development_data: 2026-09-25 ko pilot + main-study pilot utterances only
dialogue_coding.reliability_sample: stratified condition x scenario, max(20% of main utterances, 200)
dialogue_coding.held_out: separate stratified >=200 utterances never used for codebook or rule development; classifier per-category F1; new held-out set after each rule change
extras: utterance length and non-dictionary ratio over time (GlossoGen)

budget.status: information only; user 2026-09-28: tokens not a constraint on N

estimated.basis: calls/trial and growth unmeasured for v69 own-camera multi-turn; ZC2 reference 6-31 calls/trial (mean 15.2)

budget.usd_note: subscription proxy, cost_usd null, unit price not recorded
budget.action: new budget DB (new pilot_id) sized to pilot + N_max + diagnostics projection; runaway guard 1.3x; old DB untouched
